headline_stat.name: place cells / pyramidal cells (pooled, 5 linear-track sessions)

stated_limitation: The other three used a closed circular maze, where a lap wraps around and the two-direction traversal logic used throughout does not apply; they were excluded on maze geometry before any spiking data were examined.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 dorsal CA1 on a linear track is the canonical dataset, species, region, and paradigm for hippocampal place cells.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3, timebase rebuilt to fix a period-vs-frequency NWB defect and checked against MazeEpoch, corrupt concatenated units detected on raw arrays and dropped, and unit selection is explicit and defensible.
justification.analysis: Occupancy-normalised Skaggs information with a bursting-preserving circular-shift null, split-half reliability, cross-validated Bayesian decoding with a rolled-tuning-curve control, and a cross-validated Poisson GLM all correctly applied.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (211/270, 329 fields, 0.61 bits/spike, 32 cm, 6.0 Hz, 5.8–14.1 cm decoding, GLM 67/71 and 64/71) reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs and is internally consistent and physically plausible.
justification.figures: Figures show the effect clearly with units, sample sizes, a clean population diagonal, and example cells spanning a representative range of information values rather than only extremes.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to reproduced evidence, decoding was explicitly done without place-cell selection to avoid circularity, the GLM is stated to be on one prototype session, and real scope exclusions and data defects are named without overstatement.
